static_axes.control_flow: Every conditional site is enumerated with original target and source predicate. Neither target has a loop or indirect branch. Switch defaults, fall-throughs, early returns, joins, and common epilogues are separately recorded.
static_axes.algorithm: The target reads origin y, rejects out-of-grid coordinates, optionally reports ay>63, always derives map tile/life outputs for valid x/y, honors cache sentinel -2 by changing it to -1 and returning, then compares the word/tile caches plus forced row-0 invalidation. On a mismatch it calls the life/tile or ground renderer with scaled pixel coordinates, then caches the post-helper draw word and tile byte.
